title: VTC broadcast: crates and media-plane adapter
description: Crate side of jmap-chat-spec epic xpzz (VTC broadcast livestreams, protocol-neutral). Protocol parts are blocked on those spec decisions. The VtcBackend media hooks must fit at least three very different backends (AWS packager pipeline, WHEP/SFU-egress service, free-tools reference); the AWS adapter is one adapter, not the design target.
